assessment_objectives.objective: the frequency at which to review approved exceptions is defined.
approved exceptions are reviewed at the defined frequency against current risks and threats.
the determination of whether a reviewed exception is allowed to continue is documented, including the rationale and the approving individual or role.
exceptions determined not to continue are closed and the underlying non-conformity is remediated or re-submitted for approval.
records of exception reviews are retained that evidence the review date, the risks and threats considered and the continuation decision.
